title_en: Fall 2026 Course Offering Data Transfer to eTL
summary: Course offering information for Fall 2026, including course registration information, will be transferred into the eTL system on Tuesday, 18 August 2026, from 10:00 to 18:00; the work time may change depending on circumstances. Users may check the course offering information on eTL (https://etl.snu.ac.kr) from 18:00 on 18 August 2026. No action is required, and all eTL services remain available during the work.
applies_to: Not stated. The notice is for general reference by eTL users; no group is required to act.

dates.what: Transfer of Fall 2026 course offering information into eTL (work time may change depending on circumstances)
Course offering information can be checked on eTL

conditions: The work time may change depending on circumstances.
The system will not be shut down; all services remain available during the work.
steps: From 18:00 on Tuesday, 18 August 2026, check the Fall 2026 course offering information on eTL at https://etl.snu.ac.kr.
translation:
Title: Notice of Transfer of Fall 2026 Course Offerings to eTL

To support operations for Fall 2026, course offering information will be transferred into the eTL system. Please take this into account when using the system.

1. Content: All Fall 2026 course offering information (including course registration [수강신청] information)

2. Schedule: Tuesday, 18 August 2026, 10:00–18:00
※ The work time may change depending on circumstances.

3. Administrative matters
- Checking course offering information on eTL (https://etl.snu.ac.kr): from Tuesday, 18 August 2026, 18:00
- All services remain available without any system shutdown.
